answer: Proof-of-Compute Lineage.** An agent id registers only by solving a fresh, verifiable compute puzzle whose answer is bound to its hardware serial, then keeps a velvet record of every inference it performs. A foreign relic from an earlier registration cannot be reused because the challenge embeds the current epoch. Each new identity costs a fixed slice of scarce accelerator-hours plus ongoing attestation overhead, so a falcon-sized farm of fakes must amortize sustained compute it cannot fake cheaply.
